highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Skia m152 engine.
highlights_body: It expands Vulkan support, improves Windows and Nano Server packaging, fixes native lifetime hazards, and streamlines HarfBuzzSharp shaping.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 152 and includes upstream servicing, stability, and use-after-free fixes.
Adds managed Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can use Skia's next-generation GPU backend.
SKImage and SKSurface gain backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and restores its production packaging.
SKPixmap subset and With operations retain their pixel source, avoiding native use-after-free failures.
SKRegion.SpanIterator keeps its source region alive while native iteration is in progress.
SKImage.Create releases CoTaskMem pixel buffers when raster-image creation fails.
Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the previous native uniform buffer.
Nano Server uses FreeType for system-font support.
Packaging now produces Apple native symbol packages and ensures Android symbols have deterministic identities.
SKData.SaveTo, tag formatting, encoded-text access, runtime-effect uniform lookup, and handle registration avoid unnecessary allocations or repeated work.
HarfBuzzSharp Font.Shape no longer defensively copies its Feature array.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the m152 engine, Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, Vulkan Silk.NET support, and Nano Server fonts.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: The release candidate added native symbol packages, upstream m152 fixes, lifetime fixes, and HarfBuzzSharp performance improvements.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp shaping avoids copying Feature arrays, while conversion and packaging work keep the bundled bindings aligned with the release.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 adds Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also begins the Skia m152 engine update.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 adds m152 stability and packaging improvements.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It includes native lifetime fixes and new symbol packages.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers the stable Skia m152 release.
